text:
Predicates:
Orchestra(x) ::: x is an orchestra.
Premiered(x, y) ::: x premiered y.
Leads(x, y) ::: x leads y.
Conducts(x, y) ::: x conducts y.
MusicPiece(y) ::: y is a music piece.
Composer(x, y) ::: x is the composer of y.
Wrote(x, y) ::: x wrote y.
Premiere(x, y) ::: x is a premiere of y.
Conductor(x) ::: x is a conductor.
Question-specific predicate:
SomeOrchestrasPremiereMusic ::: Some orchestras premiered music pieces.

Premises:
MusicPiece(symphonyNo9) ::: Symphony No. 9 is a music piece.
Composer(beethoven, symphonyNo9) ::: Beethoven wrote Symphony No. 9.
Premiered(viennaMusicSociety, symphonyNo9) ::: Vienna Music Society premiered Symphony No. 9.
Orchestra(viennaMusicSociety) ::: Vienna Music Society is an orchestra.
Leads(beethoven, viennaMusicSociety) ::: Beethoven leads the Vienna Music Society.
Orchestra(x) → ∃y (Conducts(x, y)) ::: Orchestras are led by conductors.

Conclusion:
∃x (Orchestra(x) ∧ Premiered(x, y)) ::: Some orchestras premiered music pieces.
